column1: # The suite modes measured by hand before a release, one row per mode and
# surface: the cases the run ran, the day it was measured, and why CI does not
# run it. scripts/checks/tx-ecosystem.sh fails a hand run whose count of cases
# differs from its row; scripts/checks/conformance-badges.sh draws one badge
# per row and writes the table of the book's conformance page from this file.
